messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: High error rate detected in inference runtime (prod). Metric: 5xx-rate spike on /v1/generate. Affected: hosted customers in us-west-2. Page on-call: @maya.k :rotating_light:

maya.k: I’m on it. grabbing context now.

sam.t: seeing spikes at 14:08 UTC, coincides with the quantized model rollout to the slow pool. errors look like OOM while serving kv-cache miss paths. log sample: `2026-03-15T14:08:13Z ERROR serve: kv_get failed: out of memory`

leo.r: I’m pausing the rollout and initiating rollback on the quantized variant. command I ran: ```redwood deploy rollback --model model-v3-quant --region us-west-2 --to model-v3-fp16``` rollback in progress, ETA ~2m.

amelia: Customer impact: two mid-market customers reported timeouts and increased 5xx. Support tickets #INC-2378 and #INC-2379 opened. Estimated affected qps ~130 (from cost dashboard).

devin: while rollback proceeds, I disabled batching on the slow pool to eliminate KV cache combo for now: `redwood runtime update --pool slow-pool --batching disabled` reverted to per-request path.

ryan: good call. also spun up 4 extra nodes in the dedicated fleet as short-term capacity buffer: `autoscale override --pool slow-pool --count 4 --ttl 20m`

maya.k: rollback completed at 14:10:53 UTC. error rate dropping. tracing shows tail latencies back to normal by 14:12. Marking mitigated. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated by rollback + batching disable + scaling. root-cause hypothesis: interaction between new quantized kernel and KV cache invalidation path, causing memory regression under certain sequence lengths.

sam.t: saving traces and memory profiles to /var/snapshots/incidents/2273456789. snippet from profiler: `peak_rss increased by 2.8x on quant path when kv-cache present and seq_len>2048`

nina: We need a post-incident review (PIR). Suggest meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Can we confirm attendees: maya, sam, leo, devin, infra lead (ryan), product (amelia), and QA?

leo.r: +1. I'll prepare the rollout artifact and the quantization config that went out.

maya.k: scheduling PIR: https://meet.redwood.com/room/pir-2273456789 (tomorrow 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC). Added calendar invites.

amelia: I'll draft the customer impact notes and send an external status update template for Support.

devin: immediate action items from the mitigation:
- revert CVA: pin quantized variants behind feature flag with gating tests (owner: devin, due: 2026-03-20)
- add memory regression smoke test for kv+quant combos (owner: sam.t, due: 2026-03-18)
- add automatic rollback on >1.5x memory increase within 5 minutes of rollout (owner: leo.r, due: 2026-03-22)

maya.k: and on the incident ops side:
- improve pager message with impacted customers list (owner: maya.k, due: 2026-03-17)
- capture runbook step to disable batching safely (owner: ryan, due: 2026-03-17)

ryan: I'll also open infra ticket to add a mem-pressure alert specifically for the slow pool when kv-cache is enabled + quant flag. (ticket: INFRA-6142)

sam.t: quick repro steps for the PIR: include seq_len distribution, kv-cache enabled, quant flag on. command to run locally in dev: ```python repro.py --model model-v3-quant --seq-len 2300 --kv --concurrency 4``` logs go to repro-out.log

amelia: Support outreach plan: initial status sent, awaiting affected-customer list from billing. I'll coordinate updates and postmortem links when PIR occurs.

ops-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: created incidents/2273456789 in tracker. JIRA links added: PIR-2273 (postmortem), INFRA-6142, RUNTIME-3821 (kv smoke), RUNTIME-3822 (quant pin gating).

nina: For remediation tracking in the PIR, let's add a small table to the postmortem with columns: action, owner, due_date, status, verification_plan. We can paste that into the PIR doc during the meeting.

maya.k: Confirming owners inline: devin -> RUNTIME-3822, sam.t -> RUNTIME-3821, leo.r -> RUNTIME-3823 (auto-rollback), ryan -> INFRA-6142, maya.k -> OPS-2279 (pager improvements).

sam.t: I’ll attach memory profiles and the cron traces to PIR-2273 before the meeting.

leo.r: note for follow-up: investigate whether batching backpressure logic interacts with kernel code paths causing premature eviction of KV entries. Might need a change in KV eviction strategy or different kernel selection when seq_len distribution is high.

devin: long-term: add quant-compatibility matrix to model catalog: which kernels + kv cache patterns are certified. (owner: product+runtime, due: 2026-04-15)

maya.k: closing the incident channel for live mitigation. Parking thread for PIR coordination and action tracking. If anything else crops up, reopen. Thanks all. :pray:

ops-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: mitigated at 2026-03-15T14:12:30Z; postmortem scheduled.

nina: tagging follow-ups: please update the JIRA tickets with verification steps and attach test artifacts after fixes are merged.

maya.k: I'll run a short war room for the first 48h to monitor for regression; check-in at 14:00 UTC both days.

ryan: ack. I'll keep the scaling override for 20m increments until automated autoscaler has further tuning.

amelia: customer comms draft will be in PIR-2273 doc.

sam.t: thanks team.

maya.k: nice work everyone.
